task: D6.1 opt-in read-only market observation page shadow comparison
decision: The existing market observation page keeps its URL, layout, business fields, cache behavior, and legacy data source. An explicit manager_compare=true request bypasses the cached page response so it can attach a read-only manager shadow with versions, checksums, full status counts, bounded snapshot counts, and sampled YZ/pool comparison summaries.
fixtures: market observation shadow is disabled without network access while MANAGER_UI_DATA_SOURCE=legacy
market observation shadow separates full status counts from bounded snapshot row counts
market observation shadow propagates chainId, limit, sampleLimit, legacyAnchorScope, and request id
market observation comparison reports yzPairs, pools, abnormalYzPairs, and abnormalPools without changing legacy fields
market observation route attaches managerShadow only when manager_compare=true
successful opt-in keeps dataSource=legacy and preserves existing cache semantics for normal requests
knownBoundary: Candidate, closed-loop, and market observation pages now have opt-in manager shadows. Review, submission/broadcast, and overview pages still use legacy-only paths. Market observation shadow is not a production cutover and does not satisfy the M4 production dual-read. No production database migration, service restart, manager write, or broadcast was performed.
